text.body:
|| jñānasiddhyāgamaḥ ||
jñānaṃ rāṣṭrādyathā jñeyaṃ grāmaṃ mālākalāṃśakam | prāṇa vāyvaṃśa bhedaṃ yā''tma bhedaṃ gajo'sya ca || 1 ||
paśupāśa vidhāneṣu ajñāna coditā dhvajam | daśanāda dhvanirvādya śuddhiśaivājña sambhavam || 2 ||
ityarthaiḥ sadṛśaṃ kuryāddaśāṅgasya vidhikramam | vedānta siddhānta nādānta vidyābodhānta || 3 ||
bhedaiḥ samayāntakāntaiḥ sacchāmbhavāntassahamudrikāntaḥ | tatvānta sādhakāntañca bodhakāntaparāntakaḥ || 4 ||
śivāntairmuktānta bhedaiḥ ṣoḍaśanta iti sthitam | ekaikāntaṃ sadā dṛśyantatsaṃbandhena hi siddhijam ||
muktyarthaṃ tadbhavennityamekaikaṃ paradarśanam | turyātīte parāvasthā pade tatpara darśanam ||
upaśānte samāvasthe parātpara śivaṃ dṛśet | tvaṃ tatpade * * * * * * vedānta darśanam ||
|| siddhāntam-
atha mantrasya śuddhena yogāṣṭāṅgasya nirṇayam | jñānajñeya jñātṛnnāntaṃ muktāntena śivaṃ dṛśet ||
sadānante tathā nṛtta nṛttante śāmbhavasya tu | divyāgamārthena siddhartha * * * * darśanam ||
|| nādāntam ||
medhādi nādānta pade pareṇa śaktyantabhedaiḥ samanāntakāntaiḥ | antye parā śakti pareṣu yojyaṃ nādāntamabhyāsaka nityasiddhiḥ ||
* svapna suṣuptyarthe caturviṃśat ṣaṣṭha pakvakam | tatva bhinnodaya granthaiḥ puruṣārthaṃ prakāśitam ||
p. 2)
tacchūnye kevalā vasthā tatturye jīva darśanam |
śuddha kevala darśanam |
ityarthe svaprakāśasya bodhāntastatra ucyate || 2 ||
tadbhāve santataṃ sthitvā tannitye tatprakāśitam |
|| yogāntam ||
yamādyaṣṭāṅgayogena samantārthassamādhaye | santataṃ satataṃ sthitvā'ṇimādyaṣṭasiddhijam ||
ātmā siddhānta viśeṣa niṣṭhā * * * * * * | * * * * * * * * vehi mahārthasādhakaiḥ ||
tattatparāśāndaha sādhakena siddhyarthaśuddhamahadartha siddham |
satyāntam ||
yogena mantrānanatāradṛśyairutpannanādāntaguṇābhidhānaiḥ | saṃyogya keṇodakabandhatāraiḥ sandarśanaṃ tatsada satyavantam ||
samayāntam ||
anye'ṣṭau karabheda kaṣṭasamaye'tyanta mohādṛśeḥ anyāyairjalpamātrairaparimita kalpā bhāṣāntaveṣāntare ||
tattanmānasa bhāvabheda nisamai mantre pare vedāntāgamayevaya kānta samayāntasthe parābodhakam ||
śāmbhavāntam ||
śāṃbhave pañcabhede tantrātīteṣu śāmbhavika mudrāḥ | tanmudrādṛśabodhaiḥ satyajñānaprakāśa śāmbhaveti ||
mudrāntam ||
mudrānta nṛttakāntaṃ svarūpāntaṃ tantre bodhakānantam | tadā nandairyujya mokṣaṃ tadbhāve siddhipraśāṃbhava prakāśam ||
tatvāntam ||
tatvatrayavidhānasya yayā kuṇḍalivigrahe | saṃyojya bodhatatvāntantasya lakṣaṇam ||
p. 3)
sādhakāntam ||
na marubhaya subandho hi jvālāmaye sadāśuddhe | himakara dinakara bandhe siddhyarthadvādaśodayaṃ satve ||
vedhakāntam ||
ātmavedhakaparavedhaka śivavedhakaṃ malaṃ vedhakam | svātmabaddha samavedhakaṃ sulabhaśānti svarūpasukhavedhakam ||
gātravedhaka bhedakāntaṃ kalāparodaya vedhakaṃ sākṣikevalavedhakāntaguṇaśāṅkaram ||
parama śāmbhavam ||
parāntam ||
vāntaṃ granthirūpaṃ granthyantaṃ puruṣa kevalābhāvam | kevala bhāva paro'haṃ viśvagrāsāntaśānta suparāntam ||
tvaṃ pada śūnya padeṣu kevala rūpaṃ parodaya vyāpakaṃ | antye paraśivamanya parātparānandam ||
jīvantaṃ mukti parāmuktiḥ śivamuktitrayātmakam | svarūpa svasvarūpeṇa sūkṣma rūpeṇa mokṣavān ||
ati sūkṣma svarūpeṇa mudrārthena vimukti ca | muktānte nṛttanṛttānte muktyartha bhedakam |
nṛttānandi pade vyāptaṃ muktyantaṃ mokṣa śāmbhavam | ṣoḍaśāntamiti khyātaṃ śuddha śaivasya nirṇayam ||
devyuvāca-
devadeva jagannātha śivānanda maheśvara | śuddha śaivasya siddhāntaṃ śuddhaśūnya prakāśakam ||
śuddha sanmārga tatvārthaṃ śuddhavedānta sādhanam | śuddhajñānamayākāraṃ śuddhayogaṃ kimucyate ||
maheśvara uvāca-
śṛṇu devi tathā proktaṃ sarva śāstrārtha durlabham | sarvaveda * mārthasya yatsāraṃ tatparātparam ||
p. 4)
yattatvantat parākāraṃ parabindūdbhavaṃ tathā | parāparādidhātānta dvādaśaṃ tatva ucyate || 31 ||
parātparo patparopannāparā śaktastadudbhavam | icchājñāna kriyāśakti tadbhavā śakti rudbhavam || 32 ||
jñānecchā svakriyāmadhye śivaśaktiḥ sadāśivam | nādabindu vibhedoktaṣṣaṭ tatvaṃ na prakāśitam || 33 ||
sadā śivānmaheśasya ma * * drādbhavaṃ tathā | rudrotpattiryathā viṣṇustadā utpanna ātmabhūḥ || 34 ||
sṛṣṭikālavidhānoktaṃ sarvatatva prakāśitam | brahmā viṣṇuśca rudraśceśvaraśca sadāśivaḥ || 35 ||
bindunāda dvidhā * * śivaṃ paraparātparam | tanmadhye druhiṇādīnāñcatuṣke sakalodbhavam || 36 ||
sādākhyaṃ bindu nādoktaṃ sakalākala mucyate | śivaśakti parastrīṇi parātpara caturthakam || 37 ||
icchājñāna kriyātma * * * lañceti kīrtyate | parātparaṃ dvidhāvāntaṃ tatvasāraṃ hi śodhanam || 38 ||
sakalaṃ niṣkalaṃ caivo bhayostrīṇi vargakam | trivargagastrīṇa madhyasthe ātmavidyā śivatrayam | ṣaḍviṃśa bhedoktaṃ tat strīṇyudbhava sādhanam || 39 ||
icchājñāna kriyā tatve navaśaktistadudbhavam | śaktyādi svaparāntāni prāsādāgrodbhavaṃ tathā || 40 ||
nava śaktirvidhiproktā navamūlāgama yāmalam | tat śā * * * * * ñcaiva tatva siddha śāmbhavam || 41 ||
p. 5)
śāṃbhavaṃ pañcamaṃ proktaṃ tatva dīkṣārtha śodhanam || 42 ||
satyaśāmbhava śuddhācodagraśāṃbhavamuttarāt | anuktāśśāṃ bhavaśceti śāmbha * * * lakṣaṇam || 43 ||
vedāntārtha navaṃ jñānaṃ siddhantaṃ paramaṃ śubham | vedasya vihitācāra dakṣiṇācāra mucyate || 44 ||
viparītaṃ vāmamārgaṃ śākto'yaṃ śaivagocaram | icchā jñāna kriyāśakti madhye * * * mantikā || 45 ||
mantrā śaktyudbhavaṃ śeṣaṃ vāk śaktyāḥ pañcamastathā | parā parātparākāraṃ śivaśaktistadudbhavam || 46 ||
nādabindūdbhavākāramoṃkāraṃ śuddhatatvakam | śuddha jñāna * * * * śuddhaṃ vā śaktikāraṇam || 47 ||
jñānabījaṃ parākāramoṃkāraṃ prabhurīśvaram | sadākhyasya śivākāraṃ kalāpañcama sambhavam || 48 ||
akārokāramakāra bindunādaṃ ca pañcasu | oṃkāra sakalākāra * * * pañcamodbhavam || 49 ||
mahāsūkṣmaṃ nādamutpannaṃ sūkṣmādbindu samudbhavam | paśyanti tanmakārojaṃ ukāro madhyamodayam || 50 ||
akārotpanna vaikharyā ādivāk pañcasādhanam | tanmadhyeśāna īśaṃ ca rudra viṣṇvātma bhūritam || 51 ||
pañcamaḥ sakalīśaktiḥ pañcaśantyudbhavaṃ tathā | sṛṣṭyādi pañca kṛtyarthaṃ brahmāderdaiva sambhavam || 52 ||
brahmaṇā śatakoṭyaṃśa vaiṣṇavaṃ koṭi tatsamam | rudrabhedamaneka * * * bhedāṣṭaviṃśatiḥ || 53 ||
p. 6)
sādākhyaṃ pañcamaṃ proktaṃ nādabindu caturthakam | icchā jñānakriyāśakti para māyā ca pañcadhā || 54 ||
sadāśivaṃ nādaśivaṃ nādāntasya parāśivam | mantrarūpaśivaṃ cātmā śivaṃ pañcama tacchivam || 55 ||
nirākāraṃ tvatparaṃ ca śakāraṃ triparāṃśakam | parāntaṃ paranādāntaṃ śivāntaṃ triparātparam || 56 ||
sṛṣṭikāle tribindvarthe trikoṇākāra sambhavam | tatsthānaṃ baindavaṃ tatvaṃ bījatraya samudbhavam || 57 ||
nādabindustathākāraṃ binduśaktistadudbhavam | nādāntādi dharaṇyāntaṃ ṣaṭtriṃśattatvarūpakam || 58 ||
tanmadhye praṇavākāraṃ tadbījātmodbhavaṃ tathā | trikoṇasya mahāmadhye caturvarṇaṃ samāśritam || 59 ||
evaṃ madhyagataṃ bījaṃ kāmabījaṃ parāṃśakam | muktibījamitikhyātaṃ sarvamantrātmakaṃ param || 60 ||
trikoṇabījaṃ tridhākāre ṛgyajuḥ sāmamudbhavaḥ | madhyame praṇavotpannamadharve dantadantakam || 61 ||
tatsarvaṃ kuṇḍalī vyāptaṃ sarvatatvārtha kāraṇam | trivedaṃ karma kāṇḍānāṃ atharvaṃ jñānarūpakam || 62 ||
nidantaṃ pariśivātmadvayoraikyaṃ parātparam | tatsama vratāya siddhyarthaṃ daśāvasthā vivedhakam || 63 ||
tattatsanmārga siddhyarthaṃ tattatsanmārga sādhanam | tattadvidhā mahāvidyā taccedāntavidhisthitām || 64 ||
vedāntaṃ śaiva siddhāntaṃ dvayoraikyaṃ śivātparam | śuddhaśaiva svasaṃvedyaṃ śuddhasanmārgarūpakam || 65 ||
p. 7)
caturvedaṃ yadiśvetaṃ vedaṃpañca vibhedakam | akārādi kalāpaṃca sthāne tadvāk bhavodbhavam || 66 ||
brahmādyaiśāna paryantaṃ kalāpañcama kāraṇam | sadyojātādikaṃ vedhāṃ īśānāntaṃ sadāśivam || 67 ||
mūrtiḥ pañcama madhyasthe'ṣṭāviṃśāgamodbhavam | bindunādaparāśakti śivaśaktistu pañcadhā || 68 ||
tanmadhyemūla tantrāṇāṃ aṣṭāviṃśāgamodbhavam | tattadābhyantaraśśakyennava tantrāgamodbhavam || 69 ||
vāgmīvṛttiḥ pañcamaśśaktirmadhye vedodbhavaṃ tathā | sarva varṇaṃ svaśāstrārthaṃ bindu tatvodbhavaṃ tathā || 70 ||
divyāgama vṛttiḥ || tantrāvatāravivekaḥ | navāgama rahasyārthe'ṣṭāviṃśatodayam || 71 ||
parātparaṃ dvedhā śivaśakti samanvitā | bindunādakalākārā parāśaktisamanvitā | śivaḥ sādākhyayorbhedā mūrti sādākhya saṃbhavāḥ || 72 ||
evametatkramārthāṃśī vibhavaṃ tannavā gamam | śaktyarthaṃ yāmalodbhedaṃ navabhedamanekadhā || 73 ||
śivaḥ śaktistathā binduḥ nādaḥ sādākhya pañcamam | mūlāṣṭaviṃśatiśśāstraṃ jātāḥ sarvatra kāraṇam || 74 ||
sadyaṃ vāmamaghoraṃ ca puruṣaiśāna pañcamam | tattatproktamataṃ śāstraṃ kāmikādyaṣṭaviṃśatiḥ || 75 ||
siddhinnāmāgamaśśāstraṃ sārannamāgama trayam | kālottarādibhirbhinnaṃ tanmūlasyopa bhedakam || 76 ||
kāmikādirvibhedārthaṃ śatadvyaśatādhikam | veda sārāgamaṃ śāstraṃ vedāntañcāgamāntakam || 77 ||
p. 8)
mūrtaika mūrtikā proktaṃ vedāgamadvibhedakam | vāk caturvarṇyamadhyasthe śāstraṃ sarvoditaṃ bhavet || 78 ||
mūlāgamāñca sanmārgaṃ sahamārgaṃ śivaṃ gamam | śivasṛṣṭi pañcamākāraṃ śaktyāgamantu aṣṭamam || 79 ||
sādākhyaṃ pārvatī proktaṃ tantrā vā tārayo navaḥ | devasāraṃ daśāṃśaṃ ca gaṇeśa sāraikayo daśa || 80 ||
vāma gauravadyorbhedaṃ gautamañca gaṇeśvaram | nandī keśaṃ pañcadaśamaindusāraṃ suṣoḍaśam || 81 ||
gaurīsārāgamaṃ pañcāmaheśāsāraṃ tataḥ param | aghorasārāgamaṃ paścādviṣṇusāramataḥ param || 82 ||
brahmasāraṃ tataḥ paścāttataḥ samayasārakam | mahodbhavodbhavaṃ caiva rudrāvatāra sambhavam || 83 ||
saundaryaṃ siddhasāraṃ ca mahāgāmantu ṣaṣṭhamam |
kha samamatam ||
sādākhyaṃ pārvatī proktamātantrāvatārayo navaḥ || 84 ||
devasāraṃ daśāṃśañca tasmādgaurava sammatam | ityaṣṭa viṃśatirbhedo mūlapādāna kāraṇam || 85 ||
caturviṃśañca tadveti hyaṣṭāviṃśo vibhedakam | anyāṣṭa bheda saṃkalpamaṣṭa vidyeśvaroditam || 86 ||
evamaṣṭāviṃśatirbhedā sāraṃ tantrāvatārakam | sanmārgaṃ sahamārgaṃ ca mūladivyāgamoditam || 87 ||
idaṃ śāstraṃ śivovākyaṃ mūlatantrāvatārakam | nandikeśaṃ mahāproktaṃ kiñcittantrāvatārakam || 88 ||
sahasradivyāgamārthasya sāraṃsārottaraṃ śubham |
p. 9)
mūlāgamantu sanmārgaṃ sarvamārgaṃ śivāgamam || 89 ||
śivasṛṣṭiśaktirityarthaṃ sādākhye pārvatīmatam | tantrāvatārayoraikya namaḥ śuddha śaivakāḥ || 90 ||
śuddha śaivāgame'tyarthaṃ manya caivānya tantrakam | nandikeśaṃ paraṃ guhyaṃ yoga jñāna pravartakam || 91 ||
śivasāṃkhyaṃ yogasāṃkhyaṃ sāṃkhyaṃ bhedāgamadvayam | nirvāṇasāra sāṃkhyaika jñānasāra dvitīyakam || 92 ||
tatvasāraṃ tridhābhedaṃ devi vighne śayorguhaḥ | kāraṇaṃ mārgavaṃ śuddhaṃ ka * kaṇṭhaṃ tato'dhikam || 93 ||
śaiva bhedāgame'tyarthaṃ sākṣānmokṣa praveśakam | pūrvakāṇḍamiti proktaṃ sūkṣma siddhānta śāmbhavam || 94 ||
uttaraḥ kāṇḍayaḥ paścādyaparaṃ kāmikādikam | kāmikaṃ yogajaṃ cintyaṃ kāraṇatvajitaṃ tathā || 95 ||
dīptaṃ sūkṣmaṃ sahasraṃ cāṃśumān su prabhedakam | vijayaṃ caiva niśvāsaṃ svāyaṃbhuvamathānalam || 96 ||
vīrañca rauravañcaiva mākuṭaṃ vimalaṃ tathā | candrajñānaṃ ca bimbañca prodgītaṃ lalitaṃ tathā || 97 ||
siddhaṃ sāntānasārvoktaṃ pāramaiśvaryameva ca | kiraṇaṃ vātulaṃ caivāṣṭā viṃśati saṃhitāḥ || 98 ||
kāmikādi tathā pañca sadyojātānanodbhavam | dīptādiḥ pañcamo bhedaḥ vāmadevānanodbhavam || 90 ||
vijayādi pañcamo bhedaṃ tantrāghorānanodbhavam | rauravādistathā pañca tatpuruṣānanoditam || 100 ||
p. 10)
prodgītādyaṣṭamo bheda mīśānānānanoditam | i * * viṃśatiśśāstre rūpa bhedāgama kramam || 101 ||
caturviṃśecchata dvaivā tattadbhedā parimmitā | aparāṣṭaviṃśatirbhedā śaivasiddhāntakalpanā || 102 ||
pūrvāṣṭa viṃśati proktā catuṣpādajñeya kalpanā | anyathā āgamaḥ proktaḥ śivadharmottaraṃ dvidhā || 103 ||
nānācāra pravṛttyarthā nānā siddhānta bhedakaḥ | pauṣkarā yoga sāṃkhyārthāstatvasārādhibhedakāḥ || 104 ||
akekārthāgamaḥ saṃkhyāścatuṣpādā * * * * | devi kālottara skandakālottara dvayottarāḥ || 105 ||
sarvajñānottaraḥ saṃkhyā ityādi jñāna saṃkhyakāḥ | nānā śaiva pravṛttyarthe nānā śaivāgamoditāḥ || 106 ||
anantāgamayoḥ saṃkhyā ādi kāleśa kalpanā | mantra tantra kriyā yogāt jñānaṃ śaivārtha nirṇayam || 107 ||
śaiva śāktodbhavaṃ tatvaṃ śāktaṃ śaivodbhavaṃ tathā | ubhayaṃ sampuṭīkṛtya parā prāsādavedhakam || 108 ||
prāsāda parayoraikyaṃ śāmbha * * * * ditam | śiva śaktyātmakaṃ pādaṃ śuklarakta prakāśakam || 109 ||
tadaikyaṃ viśrānti tatvaṃ tadbhāvaṃ paramaṃ padam | śaivaṃ śāktamayaṃ tatvaṃ tatvātītaṃ paraṃ śivam || 110 ||
kulārṇavaṃ kulottīrṇaṃ kulasadbhāvaṃ kulāmṛtam | parottarāgamārthañca kālīkākulaśāsanam || 111 ||
p. 11
siddhāmṛtāmnayā siddhirityādiśśākta vāmajam | navayāmalayorbhedaṃ tattadbhedamanekadhā || 112 ||
śākteyaṃ śāmbhava * * * * * sambandhakāraṇam | traividyāntamiti proktamidaṃ śāstra trimelanam || 113 ||
śuddha śaivamitikhyātaṃ śuddha śāmbhava sambhavam | prāsāda parayoraikyaṃ śuddhaśaivaṃ dvidhā * * || 114 ||
śākteyaṃ śāmbhavaṃ śaivaṃ vedāntamāgamāntaram | nādāntavanna nāṭāntañca sakyaṃ drāntaśāmbhavam || 115 ||
evaṃ navāntayaśśuddhi śuddhaśaivā prakāśakam | sadyontaṃ praṇavāgraṃ ca mudrāntaṃ tannisādhanam || 116 ||
pā * * * * * proktaṃ ṣaḍaśasyopabhedakam | vratakālāmukhaḥ proktā ekaikaḥ pañcapañcamaḥ || 117 ||
bhairavasyāṣṭabhedāśca catuṣṣaṣṭyopabhedakāḥ | vāmaṃ ṣoḍaśa * * * * * tadbhedamanekadhā || 118 ||
dvādaśaṃ śaiva bhedāśca tadviśeṣakaṃ śivādvitim | lakulīśvarayorbhedāḥ pañcadhā parikīrtitāḥ || 119 ||
śaivānya bhedakāṣṣaṣṭhi saṃkhyā saṃkhyāgamārthakāḥ || 120 ||
nānā koṭyaṃśa * śaṃ mūrtibhedāgamārthikam | binduśaktirbhavedyevaṃ vāgbhavaṃ śāstrakalpitam || 121 ||
baindavaḥ kalahaśśāstrā parajñāna pravartakāḥ | śāstraṃ tatparamaṃ guhyaṃ parātparatara * * || 122 ||
nānābhedāgamārthantu taccatuṣpāda kalpanā | anantāgamayormadhye sārāt sarāṣṭaviṃśati || 123 ||
p. 12)
tanmūlāgama tadbhedā navadhā mūla kalpanā | tattatsārāṃśa sārārthaṃ tantrāvatāra śāstrakam || 124 ||
vedāgamarahasyārthe vedāgamānta vismayam | śuddha śaiva prakāśārtha śuddha śāṃbhava saṃbhavam || 125 ||
śuddhaśaivastathā sāraṃ sārātsāraṃ prakāśitam | sārātsārataraṃ guhyaṃ guhyādguhyaṃ prakāśitam || 126 ||
śāktasya śāṃbhavaṃ śaivaṃ śiva śāmbhava śāktakam | vedānta siddhānta vijñāna gamyaṃ vedānta siddhānta tadjñānagamyaṃ
dvyaikatvam ||
vedānta siddhānta bhinnairabhinnaṃ vedānta siddhānta viśrāntimuktim |
śuddhaśaivasvasiddhāntamidaṃ śāstrapravartakam | śuddhaśūnya prakāśatvaṃ vyomakeśaṃ paraṃśivam || 127 ||
śuddhasanmārga tatvārthaṃ śuddhajñāna prakāśitam | śuddha vedānta tatvārthaṃ tatvamasmādi śobhanam || 128 ||
śuddhajñāna mayākāra parāvaraparaṃ gurum | śuddhayogakalātītaṃ unmanyantaṃ paraṃ śivam || 129 ||
pūrvokta vāsanā proktaṃ idaṃ devi varānane | śuddha śaiva pravṛttyartha samāhiteti śaṅkari || 130 ||
|| jñāna siddhyāgame prathamastantrāvatārasaṃhitādhikāraḥ samāptaḥ ||
devyuvāca-
deva deva mahādeva mahāyogi maheśvara | maheśāna mahāmantri vandyate tvamahaṃ śivam || 1 ||
p. 13)
acintya jñāna saṃketaṃ kṛtya paraṃ param | abhāva saṅketamityarthaṃ prāsāda kurvaṃ sadāśivaḥ || 2 ||
īśvara uvāca-
śṛṇu devyacintyārthaṃ śivātmaikyaṃ śivodbhavam | patipāśa paśujñānaṃ khaṇḍā khaṇḍā vikalpakam || 3 ||
śiva lakṣaṇa vivekaḥ-
śivasya lakṣaṇaṃ vakṣye samāsātparameśvari | śivaṃ parātparaṃ sūkṣmaṃ nirvikalpaṃ nirañjanam || 4 ||
tatvā tītaṃ paraṃ dantu turyātītaṃ paraṃ śivam | nādātītaṃ tu nādāntaṃ sadānandaṃ sadāśivam || 5 ||
* * * rahita brahmamakalpitamacintyakam | abhoktamamala jñānamavināśikamanātmikam || 6 ||
śuddhatvaṃ śuddha saṃketaṃ śuddhātmaṃ svaprabhāvitam | adhva ṣaḍbheda saṃketaṃ vyāptini vyāpti nirṇayam || 7 ||
prāsādaṃ paramaṃ mantraṃ parāmantraṃ tadaikyakam | prāsādaparayoraikyaṃ rakta śuklañca miśritam || 8 ||
raktaṃ śuklaṃ ca miśrañca dvividhaṃ pādalakṣaṇam | raktaṃ tvatpādamevantu śuklaṃ matpādameva ca || 9 ||
raktaśukla * * * * bhukti muktyartha kāraṇam | raktaśukla prabhābhinnaṃ śiva śaktyarthakaṃ param || 10 ||
sāntaṃ ṣāntadvayorvarṇaṃ bindunāda samudbhavam | ātmamantramitikhyātaṃ prāsāda paramākṣaram || 11 ||
|| śivalakṣaṇa vivekaḥ samāptaḥ ||
|| prāsāda vivekaḥ ||
prāśabdaṃ syācchivajñānaṃ sāśabdaṃ gatirucyate | damatsvarūpamevantu trivarṇamabhidhīyate || 12 ||
adhvā saṃketamārgaṃ * * * * * svarūpakam | varṇakalāpadaṃ tatvaṃ mantro bhuvana eva ca || 13 ||
sarvaṃ kalādi saṃsargaṃ tannivṛtyādi rūpakam | nivṛtti pratiṣṭhā vidyā ca śāntyatītaśca pañcamam || 14 ||
atmāntarātmaparaṃ jñānātmā na svamūrtakam | sarvamantratanuṃ prāpya pañcakṛtya śivaṃ kuru || 15 ||
icchājñāna kriyāśaktiricchāyāḥ pañcakṛtyakāḥ | icchājñānakriyārūpam kāraṇatrayamīśvaram || 16 ||
* * * * * * śaktiḥ pañca śaktyarthakāraṇam | pañcamonāda śaktyarthaṃ kāraṇatrayamādikam || 17 ||
binduśaktistathā pīṭhaṃ nādaśakti svaliṅgakam | bindunāda samātmānaṃ bindurephaṃ parātparam || 18 ||
paramaṃ bindumadhyasthe vaikharyādiśca toyadam | vaikharī madhyamā cāntyā paśyantī sūkṣma saṃjñakā || 19 ||
vaikharī śrotra viṣayā savikalpā tu madhyamā | nirvikalpāṃ tṛtīyāṃ vāśāṃ kāraṇamantyamaḥ || 20 ||
p. 15)
jñāna siddhyāgamaḥ |
madhyādbhavaṃ sūkṣmaṃ kārekaḥ paśyanti sambhavam | ukāre madhyotpannamakāre vaikharyoditam || 21 ||
grartisaṃyuktaṃ haṃkārokāramakāram | bindutatva pratīkāśaṃ baindavastatva rūpakam || 22 ||
bindumadhyodbhavaṃ sūkṣmamakāre paśyantī saṃbhavam | evaṃ vāgvṛtti saṃketaṃ vaikharyādi * rṇamudbhavam || 23 ||
ukāra ukāra makāra bindunādaṃ ca pañcamam | mano buddhirahaṃkāraścitta * * * * * * || 24 ||
bindumadhyoditaṃ sarvaṃ tatkālaṃ baindavaṃ tathā | layakālaṃ taṭākuṭilā tanmadhye praṇavoditam || 25 ||
o au māyātrayo bandhaṃ trivṛttāḥ kuṇḍalī tathā | tatra kuṇḍalinī madhye iḍāpiṅgalayodbhavam || 26 ||
iḍā piṅgalayormadhye suṣumnānāma svarūpakam | suṣumnābhyantare sūkṣmai citra nāṭipraveśanam || 27 ||
citranāḍisvamadhyasthe prāṇāpānasamanvitaḥ | prāṇāpānadvayo * * * * paramakāraṇam || 28 ||
hakāraṃ śivarūpatvaṃ sakāraṃ śaktirucyate | hakāra sakārayormadhye bindurūpaṃ parāyaṇam || 29 ||
bindu madhyegato nādo nāda madhye gataḥ śivaḥ | śiva madhye gataḥ śāntaṃ śāntyatītaṃ parātparam || 30 ||
sarvodita dvidhā śaktirmāyā kuṇḍalinī tathā | māyā kuṇḍalinī bhedā sarvalokaṃ carācaram || 31 ||
p. 16)
granthi janyaṃ kalākālaṃ vidyārāgendriyādayaḥ | guṇadhī garvacittākṣamātrā bhūtānya * * * || 32 ||
kuṇḍalinī śakti māyā karmānusāriṇī | nādabindvādikaṃ kāryaṃ tasyā iti jagatsthitiḥ || 33 ||
kalāṣoḍaśayorbhedaṃ mūlakuṇḍalinodbhavam | kalāṣoḍaśayorūpa candrakānte pratiṣṭhitam || 34 ||
tatra ṣoḍaśayoḥ śaktiścandradehe pratiṣṭhitam | anya mantra kalārūpaṃ prāsādaparamākṣaram || 35 ||
akāraśca ukāraśca makārobindureva ca | ardhacandra nirodhī ca nādo * * * * * * * * || 36 ||
śaktiśca vyāpinī caiva samanā conmanā tathā | samanāntaṃ pāśajālamunmanyante paraṃ śivam || 37 ||
prasthāraṃ ca vistārañca nisthāraṃ ca kriyodbhavam | sthairyamityanusandhatte prāsāde paṅktistu pañcamāḥ || 38 ||
akāra svararūpatvamukārāpīśa rūpakam | makāraṃ viṣarūpatvaṃ bindureva phakākṣaram param || 39 ||
ardhacandrastathākāraṃ nirodhe tattrikoṇakam | halabindudvayaṃ nādaṃ * * * tatpratīhalam || 40 ||
halamitrāṅgitaśśakti vyāpinī tatra śūlakam | kubjikā vyomarūpī cā nantādi śakti ṣaṣṭhamāḥ || 41 ||
ṣaḍbinduḥ cūlikākāraṃ tadagraṃ tu śalākayā | tacchivaṃ niṣkalaṃ tatvaṃ prasthārārthamiti sthitam || 42 ||
p. 17)
madhye ṣaḍavayava vyāptivistīrṇaṃ vistharakramam | ekaika yojyayorbhāvaṃ nistāraṃ nisthara kramam || 43 ||
parāntaṃ parayordṛṣṭvā sthairyamityaṅga bhāvanātmakam | tadānusaṃndhāna saṃvṛtti prāsādasta * * * || 44 ||
adhvā ṣoḍhā tatra padavarṇamastrantu sargajā | sarvasya śaktirūpatvāt ete vācaka rūpakāḥ || 45 ||
* * * * kalā tatva bhuvanānīti yatra yam | vācya rūpaṃtrika dvandvaṃ etacchakti śivātmakam || 46 ||
vācyavācaka vyutpannaṃ baindavaṃ malasambhavam | ādikāraṇa mṛdrūpaṃ taccakraṃ sahakāraṇam || 47 ||
nimittasya kulālokta triyaiva mṛdbhāṇḍa sambhavam | tato'vagranthi mṛdrūpaṃ kuṇḍalīcakra saṃsthitam || 48 ||
paradeśaṃ kulāle * kurute taccarācaram | icchājñāna kriyāśaktiriti vyāptasya kāraṇam || 49 ||
sṛṣṭyādiḥ pañcamaṃ kṛtyaṃ brahmādi * * sādhakam | sarvasṛṣṭimayaṃ bindu tanmadhye varṇamudbhavam || 50 ||
acintya kuṇḍalīśaktirmadhye sarvoditaṃ bhavet |
kṛtyartham ||
tatvātmabandhaya sṛṣṭi tadbhokta sthiti sādhanam || 51 ||
tatvātmanaḥ pṛthagbhāvaṃ tatsaṃhāraṃ samucyate | karma kurvanti tatkāla sthiro bhāvaṃ tirobhavam || 52 ||
caturthaṃ kurute kṛtyaṃ tadanugraha sādhanam |
p. 18)
evaṃ pañcamakṛtyarthaṃ pañcadivyādi saṃsthitam || 53 ||
sūkṣma kṛtyaṃ tu pañcaite kevalasyāga * * * | bodhanaṃ śodhanaṃ mūḍhaṃ bandhanaṃ śaṃsanaṃ tathā || 54 ||
mahāsaṃhāra kāle tu kuṭilāṃśo tatoditam | icchā jñāna kriyāśakti saṃgrahaṃ mūrtivigraham || 55 ||
jñāna rūpaṃ śivākāraṃ * * rūpantu śaktayaḥ | jñānakriyā samaṃ tatvaṃ tatsādākhya svarūpakam || 56 ||
jñānaśūnyaṃ kriyādhikyaṃ maheśastatva vigraham | kriyā nūnaṃ yogasiddhaṃ śuddha vidyārtha śaṅkaram || 57 ||
icchādhike kramaṃ viṣṇuḥ brahmaṇastatva mucyate | tasmādicchādayo bhedaṃ brahma viṣṇu svarūpakam || 58 ||
rudro viṣṇurvidhānoktaṃ kalpabhogādhikārakam | binduśaktistathāmadhye māyāśakti samudbhavam || 59 ||
māyāśakti madhye * * * * śaktistadudbhavam | kāmyaśaktisva madhyasthe māyeyaṃ ca tadudbhavam || 60 ||
caturmalaṃ tathā bhedyaṃ tattirodhādhikaṃ bhavet | evaṃ pañcamalaḥ śaktyāḥ pāśabandhastaducyate || 61 ||
evaṃ vigraha kṛtyarthamevaṃ satkṛtya nirṇayam | devadeva maheśāna mahāyogī maheśvara || 62 ||
yanmantraṃsāra saṃgrāhyaṃ tanmantrākāramucyate |
śaṅkara uvāca-
binduṣaṣṭhyādinādena svanāde bindu saṃbhavam || 63 ||
tadrūpaṃ praṇavākāraṃ pañca * * rṇa saṃsthitam |
p. 19)
omityekākṣaraṃ brahma paramātma svavigraham || 64 ||
oṃkāraṃ śivarūpatvaṃ tadbhedaṃ pañcamatrayam | mūlakuṇdalinī vyāptamātma mantrasvavarṇakam || 65 ||
haṃsa vidyāmahāvidyā prāsāda parayā saha | prāsādapara * * * * * śaktisvavigraham || 66 ||
prāsādaparayoraikyaṃ śāmbhavaṃ śivasambhavam | bindubhidyadi nādena sanādaḥ khena vidyate || 67 ||
bindunāda kalārūpaṃ śivaśaktisva vigraham | ādhāraṃ mānasaṃ * * * * dheyaṃ paraṃ śivam || 68 ||
bindurādhāra pīṭhaṃ ca nādaliṅgaṃ samācaret | bindubhidyaṃ sadākārabhagāṃśaṃ śaktivigraham || 69 ||
trikoṇa madhye haukāraṃ dharmahaṃsau hariṃ śivam | haṃse bindugatonāde haṃsamārge * * * * || 70 ||
nādaṃ liṅgamiti prāhuḥ bindupīṭhaṃ udāhṛtam | bindumadhye gatonādo nāda madhyegataḥ śivaḥ || 71 ||
śivamadhyagataḥ śaktiḥ śakti madhye svayaṃ śivam | parahaṃsa prabhedaṃ ca hakārahaukāra ityapi || 72 ||
haṃsaḥ paramahaṃsañca dvidhā haṃsa prabhedhakam | ahaṃ pṛthivyā ahamāpaḥ ahamīśvarameva hi || 73 ||
ahaṃ pṛthivyā ahaṃ tejo ahaṃ hariḥ | ahamākāśa sadbhūtaṃ ahamātmā ahaṃ parā || 74 ||
hakāraṃ brahmarūpatvaṃ ukāraṃ viṣṇurūpakam |
p. 20)
makāraṃ rudrarūpatvaṃ bindurīśvarameva hi || 75 ||
nādaṃ sadāśivaṃ proktaṃ nādātītaṃ paraṃ śivam | paratatvaṃ paraṃ jñeyaṃ parāmukti svarūpakam || 76 ||
hakāraṃ niṣkalopetaṃ sakāraṃ sakalaṃ bhavet | hakāraṃ śivarūpatvaṃ sakāraṃ śaktirucyate || 77 ||
hakāraḥ sūrya ityarthaḥ sakāraścandra ityapi | ikāraḥ pāvako rūpa iti jyotitrayoditam || 78 ||
hakāro kārayormadhye bindurūpamudāhṛtam | bindumadhyagatonādaṃ nāda madhyagataḥ śivaḥ || 79 ||
bindubhiṭyāti nādena sanādeḥ khena bhidyate | śiva madhyagataṃ tatvaṃ tatvamadhye parātparam || 80 ||
paraṃ parātparaṃ sūkṣmaṃ parāmukti parigraham | vyomākāraṃ mahāśūnyaṃ turyātītaṃ paraṃ śivam || 81 ||
turyātītaṃ caraṃ sthānaṃ paravyoma prakāśitam | turyātītaṃ parākāraṃ omiti jyotirūpakam || 82 ||
bālavṛddhaḥ sagārūpamādyanta rahita * * | jñānayogakriyābījaṃ kriyākarmānyavarṇakam || 83 ||
oṅkāraṃ paramātmānaṃ parāśakti prakāśitam | tasmāt jñānamayaṃ brahmamomiti jyotirūpakam || 84 ||
oṃkārodāttānudātta svaritaḥ kuṭilasvaraḥ | dhvanirantargata jyotiḥ jyotirantargataṃ manaḥ || 85 ||
manasyāntargato buddhirantargato mama | mamāntargata * cittaścittamantargatātmanaḥ || 86 ||
p. 21)
ātmāntargato kālaḥ kālamantargataḥ kalā | kālāntargatayo nādanādānta * * * parā || 87 ||
parāntargatayo jñāna jñānamantargataḥ śivaḥ | sarvāntargatayādbrahma tadbrahma tatparātparam || 88 ||
evamantargatasyārtha hau oṃ trīṇi gurudbhavaḥ | yogāṣṭāṅga prakāroktamoṃkāraṃ paramākṣaram || 89 ||
saptavyāhṛti gāyatryā sāvitrī prakṛtā kṛtim | ṣaḍaṅgāścaturvedā smṛti tyāgaṃ tato mayam || 90 ||
mā * * * * * * * * * * * tma vivekaḥ nānāntyotpannaya prāptaṃ tanmāyāmayīmayam |
māyānta sthātmakaṃ baddhaṃ pāśaṃ pañcamamācaret | pāśaṃ śodhana jīvātmā paśutacchodhanaḥ parāḥ || 91 ||
parā praṇava saṃśodhyaṃ oṃkārāntaṃ guroḥ param | guroranyat paraṃ nāsti guroranyat śivaṃ na hi || 92 ||
|| praṇava vivekaḥ samāptaḥ ||
|| atha liṅgodbhava vivekaḥ ||
praṇavaṃ bindunādoktaṃ kuṭilākāramudbhavam | kuṭilā * svaśaktyarthamuditāṃ kuravaḥ śivam || 93 ||
bindunāda kalākāraṃ praṇavaṃ talliṅgamācaret | nādāntasya kalāpāśamunmanyantaṃ tadādhikam || 94 ||
samanāntaṃ pāśajālamunmanyantaṃ paraṃ śivam | śuddhādhvā vunmanīryantantadantaṃ caraṇoditam || 95 ||
p. 22)
kāla bhuvana varṇañca mantrādhvā ca padādhva ca | tatvādhvā iti vijñeyā ṣaḍadhvā sādākhyarūpakam || 96 ||
kalādhvā vāyavaṃ proktaṃ bhuvanaṃ romameva ca | tvagvarṇā ca * * śoṇipadādhvā ca nāḍyaḥ śirāḥ || 97 ||
ṣaḍviṃśattatva khaṇḍoktaṃ dhāturūpaṃ sadāśivam | tadbheda prāṇayaśśakti tatparā śaktirucyate || 98 ||
śivamātma svarūpasthamidaṃ sādākhyamudbhavam | pañcakṛtyādhikārasthaṃ jagadyoniṃ sadāśivam || 99 ||
paramaṃ bījamadhyasthe trikoṇarekhā stanādayaḥ | trikoṇākāra madhyasthe bhagāṅgaṃ liṅgamācaret || 100 ||
bhagamadhye sthitaṃ liṅgaṃ liṅga madhye sthitaṃ bhagam | sadāśivāsanaṃ liṅgaṃ liṅgāsanaṃ tu pīṭhikā || 101 ||
pīṭhikāsana bhrūmadhye deśikā dhyānamāsanam | evaṃ dhyātvā tu manasā parāśaktistu vinyaset || 102 ||
pañcabhedantu sādākhyaṃ tadbhedaṃ ṣoḍaśodbhavam | aṣṭāviṃśaṃ maheśoktannaṭarājaṃ pradhānakam || 103 ||
parecchayā śivasādākhyaṃ tadādiḥ pañcamodbhavam | maheśa viṣṇurudrādi pañcabhūtastu pañcamam || 104 ||
sarvaṃ sādākhyamutpannaṃ kāraṇatrayamācaret | mūrtā mūrtiḥ karmamūrtiḥ śiva * ?khya pañcamam || 105 ||
rudrotpanna gaṇeśastatsvabhedaṃ ṣoḍaśaṃ tathā | rudrotpanna viśākhaśca ṣaṭbhedaika svasaṃgraham || 106 ||
p. 23)
devāsurā narāśakti ṛṣibhyaḥ kinnarādikam | sarvaṃ rudreśaromasya madhyotpannamasaṃkhyayā || 107 ||
brahmādi śivatatvānta daśasādākhya sambhavam | vedhāḥ paścimabhāge tu hṛṣīkeśottarastathā || 108 ||
aghora dakṣiṇe bhāgaṃ puruṣaṃ pūrvayoditam | īśānasthānamīśānaṃ dṛṣṭvā madhyamayoditam || 109 ||
madhyamāgrastathā bindunādaṃ rekhāgrayaśśivam | śivamadhyantu śaktyarthametat sādākhyamudbhavam || 110 ||
śāntaṃ padmāsanasthaṃ śaśidharamakuṭaṃ pañcavaktraṃ triṇetraṃ | śūlaṃ vajraṃ khaḍgaṃ paraśumabhayadaṃ vāma dakṣa bhāge vahantam || 111 ||
nāsagaṃ pāśaṃ ca ghaṇṭāṃ malanakarayutaṃ sāṃkuśaṃ vāmabhāge | nānālaṃkārayuktaṃ sphaṭikamaṇinibhaṃ saumyasādākhya tatvam || 112 ||
devīśira dakṣiṇottara supādaṃ gomukha pādāntakṛtavāri bhujayuktam | yonigata madhya madhu saṃsthita liṅga sthāpita sadāśiva-
manonmani svarūpam | manaśśaktika vijñeya unmanaḥ paramaḥ śivaḥ || 13 ||
mana unmana sambandhānmanonmanyabhidhīyate || 114 ||
vāmādyaṣṭa śaktīnāṃ madhyatejo manonmanī | manonmani ga madhyastho sādākhyaṃ liṅgamadhyamam || 115 ||
śivaśakti sthitaṃ liṅgaṃ jagadyonyudbhavastathā | navajñāṅga padmāṅgaṃ na cakrāṅgañca? gattrayam || 116 ||
liṅgāṃśañca bhagāṃśañca tasmānmāheśvarājjagat | mūlādhāraṃ catuṣpatraṃ tanmadhye vaśaṣassajam || 117 ||
p. 24)
tanmadhye kuṭilākāraṃ trikoṇākāra saṃbhavam | nāḍī mūlāvṛtāṅkābhi kuṇḍalī haṃsanisvanā || 118 ||
kuṇḍalyākāra madhyasthe prāṇaṃ praṇavasambhavam | praṇavatrayamadhyasthaṃ vyomākāraṃ parākramam || 119 ||
parākramaṃ parotpannaṃ paraṃ sarvatra kāraṇam | cidghanaṃ meghatadvyāptaṃ nityaṃ sadyotita prabham || 120 ||
sarvātma kāraṇaṃ śambhurvibhuśśarvasva sākṣikam | śambhoḥ śivaparaṃ sūkṣmaṃ sarvavyāpakamīśvaram || 121 ||
sarva varṇaṃ tathā mantraṃ mantramūrtimanekadhā | sarvakoṭi mahāmantraṃ saptakoṭyaṃśi kāraṇam || 122 ||
vijñānasyāṣṭa vidyeśaṃ mantramūrti pradhānakam | saptakoṭi mahāmantraṃ cittavyākula kāraṇam || 123 ||
ekena sahajaṃ mantraṃ turyātīte paraṃ śivam | nādabindu dvidhākāraṃ tridhāvāk pañcamodbhavam || 124 ||
kuṭilī kuṇḍalīstāraṃ baindavaiśānamīśvaram | rudravijñāna kāṣṭāṃśaṃ icchājñānakriyātmakam || 125 ||
āṇavaṃ māyayākāmyaṃ pāve?paṃca tirobhavam | sthūla sūkṣma mahān prāṇā vyaktā pañcama kañcukāḥ || 126 ||
jīvāmecchādiṣu triṃśat ṣaṭtriṃśattatvakāraṇam | kāraṇaṃ kṛtya mūlasthaṃ māyā kuṇḍalinodbhavam || 127 ||
sarva tatvaṃ mayākhyātaṃ sarvātma sṛṣṭikāraṇam | acintyaṃ tatparā śaktiścintyamāyā vikalpakam || 128 ||
p. 25)
acintyācintyayaḥ sākṣirātmarūpaṃ parātparam | sarvamantramayaṃ tārantārariśvādayoditam || 129 ||
omiti jyotirūpa jyotirūpasthaṃ satyamuktam | āsikābandhanaṃ śaivaṃ nāsikābandhanaṃ na ca || 130 ||

pañcaviṃśastu pañcānāṃ pūrvoktavidhinā tathā | sarvaśūnyo mahāyogyāvasthā garbhā vyavasthitā || 11 ||
bhūtāvasthā malāvasthā sthūlasūkṣma dvipañcamāḥ || 12 ||
sarvāvasthā vinirmuktaṃ svayamātmasvarūpakam | sarvāvasthā vinirmuktaṃ turyātītaṃ paraṃ śivam || 13 ||
p. 38)
turyātītaṃ paraṃ tatva sarvatatvārtha * * * | * ka varṇāni rūpānāmeka dudrā ca khecarī || 14 ||
ekamevaṃ nirālambo ekāvasthānamunmanī | sarvāvasthā vinirmuktā sarvacintā vivarjitā || 15 ||
maunamudrā sthitā yena śivayogī tathā bhavet | grāhyā grāhaka saṃvṛttiḥ sāmānyaṃ sarvadehinām || 16 ||
yoginānta viśeṣo'yaṃ sambandhe sthāpanāśanāḥ | sarvāvasthājayaṃ śuddhaṃ yogāṣṭāṅgā nyasetkramāt || 17 ||
avasthātītaṃ parātatvaṃ tatvātītaṃ paraṃ śivam | avasthā bhedādhikāraḥ samāptaḥ ||
devyuvāca -
jñānatatvaprakāśāya sarvatatvādhikeśvaraḥ | jñānabhedaṃ jñānaguṇaṃ jñānarūpaṃ tatodbhavam || 18 ||
jñānācārya anācārya śiṣyāśiṣyasya lakṣaṇam | jñāna nirṇaya tatvārthaṃ daśabhedaṃ kimucyate || 19 ||
śaṅkara uvāca-
śabdajñānañca tatvaṃ ca nānāsamaya darśanam | * * * * * khaṇḍaṃ ca kālā jñānasya no sahaḥ || 20 ||
cinmātrañcāpi śaive hi śaivabheda pramāṇataḥ | pāpāttu pāpanā jñānaṃ pāṣaṇḍa jñānarūpakam | samalāmala vijñāna dvyaitā vubhau samau || 21 ||
śāmbhava jñāna saṃketā siddhāntaśravaṇastathā | nigratha jñānimūḍhaṃ ca nānāsāṃkhyā prabhedakā || 22 ||
saṅkalpañca vikalpaṃ ca bodhanāḥ śodhanāyitā | prakāśā prakāśa bhedāñcāṣṭā * * * kalpanāḥ || 23 ||
śabdārtha lakṣaṇābhāsā śabdajñāni svalakṣaṇam | tatvāparimitābhyāsaṃ tatvajñāna pravartakāḥ || 24 ||
p. 39)
nānāsamayakhaṇḍārtha jñātrā samaya lakṣaṇam |
samaya vivekaḥ-
śaivaṃ śivādvita dvaidhā śiva saṃmelanaṃ trayam || 25
caturthaṃ pāśuparyantaṃ pañcamantu mahāvratam | ṣaṣṭhaṃ kālāmukhaṃ caiva saptamaṃ bhairavaṃ tathā || 26 ||
aṣṭhamaṃ vāmabhedārthaṃ sama * * * * bhavet || 27 ||
nyāyaṃ vaiśeṣikaṃ caiva bauddhaṃ māṣañcakaṃ tathā | lokāyitañca sāṃkhyaṃ ca mīmāṃsaṃ vaiṣṇvaṃ tathā || 28 ||
evamaṣṭābahirbhedaṃ bāhyābhyantara ṣoḍaśam | bhedābhedo bhaya jñāna māyāvādi pradhānakam || 29 ||
mantrayantrañca tantrāśca tarkāmārtāṇḍa vādinam | ānandāvasthitaṃ śāntaṃ śāntyatītaṃ parātparam || 30 ||
prārabdha karma pādāścānyā nyauṣadhavādinaḥ | aṣṭapādamidaṃ proktaṃ * * * caturviṃśatiḥ || 31 ||
tīrthaśāstraṃ pramāṇañca arcanādhyārtha pañcamā | brāhmyābhyantarayorbhedāḥ saṃkalpāḥ ṣaṭprabhedakāḥ || 32 ||
athāśrama caturbhedā ṣoḍaśa * * yāstathā | brahmavadvāda vādīvatva tatvavādistu śūnyakam || 33 ||
evaṃ pañcaśivotpannaṃ śrutyāgamānya tantrajam | aṣṭāviṃśat prabhedoktamarthamāyā kuṇḍalinodbhavam || 34 ||
vedānta tatva vijñāna * * * tasya sādhanam | vedārtha samayaṃ jñānaṃ tat jñānaṃ paramaṃ padam || 35 ||
traidhādvaidhakayorbhedā samyak jñāna pravartakāḥ | jīvātmā paramātmā ca dvai * * * sthitaṃ bhavet || 36 ||
svarūpe kāntaviśrānti vedāntasya ca darśanam |
p. 40)
satyajñānamanantaṃ cānantaṃ brahmarūpiṇam || 37 ||
ānandā vasthitaṃ śāntaṃ śāntyatītaṃ parātparam | nānāśāstra vikalpārthā * * * * kalodbhavam || 38 ||
nānāśāstrārthamekārthaṃ dṛṣṭvā khaṇḍa sthitaṃ bhavet | catuṣṣaṣṭi kalābhyāsaṃ kalājñānaṃ vicakṣaṇam || 39 ||
aṣṭāṅgayogamabhyāsamanyayogamanekajaḥ | * * * cetanā jñānaṃ acidbhūtañca bhūtikam || 40 ||
cidacidbhāvanā jñānaṃ vyāktāvyakta sthitaṃ bhavet | pāṣāṇāvasthito mokṣapāṣaṇḍā jñānakalpanā || 41 ||
samalaṃ sakalī bhāvamamalaṃ niṣkalaṃ tathā | dvaidhā dvaidhādikaṃ jñānaṃ dāso'haṃ so'hamāśritam || 42 ||
dvidhā miśro bhayajñānaṃ śambhusambandha śāmbhavam | pāśaṃ pāśapatātyartha jñānasiddhānta darśanam || 43 ||
gūḍha jñānādi gupitaṃ mūla jñānādi mūḍhanam | sāṃkhya bhedamanekāśca prakṛtau vikṛtau dvidhā || 44 ||
puruṣa saṃkhyāśca caturthaiḥ surasāṃkhyakāḥ | nirīśaḥ pañcamañcaiva yogasāṃkhyantu ṣaṣṭhamam || 45 ||
anyā parimidaṃ sāṃkhyaṃ sāṃkhya jñānamiti sthitiḥ | saṃkalpaṃ kalpanā jñānaṃ vikalpaṃ tatkuraṃ madam || 46 ||
bodhanātmā prakāśasthaṃ bodhanaṃ vyomadarśanam | prakāśaṃ trailokya sahajaṃ prakāśaṃ manoharam || 47 ||
ityaṣṭā viṃśati jñānaṃ tadantaṃ śuddhaśaivakam | paśupāśahare jñāna mumukṣo muktigocaram || 48 ||
pāśa jñānaṃ paśubandhamevaṃ jñānodbhavasthalam || 49 ||
p. 41)
ācāarya lakṣaṇa vivekaḥ |
ācārya lakṣaṇaṃ vakṣye samāhita maheśvara | savarṇa jñānavān baddha satyavādī dayāparaḥ || 1 ||
nānā śāstravicārārtha nānā siddhanta darśanam | jñānayoga kriyācaryā pravartaka nivartakaḥ || 2 ||
bhinnā bhinnasva siddhāntarabhinnaḥ śāśvata darśanam | sarvāvayava saṃyuktaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam | sarvajñatva samarthañca * * * jñāna tatparaḥ || 3 ||
evaṃ lakṣaṇa saṃyuktaḥ sadācāryaḥ salakṣaṇaḥ | śivo'haṃ bhāvanā jñāna śivahastāpakeśvaraḥ || 4 ||
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * bhavet | jñāna kriyā kriyācāryaścaturdīkṣādhikeśvaram || 5 ||
anācārya lakṣaṇavivekaḥ ||
kāmakrodhamadāllobhā mohamātsarya sambhavam | ahantāśca vikalpāśca * * * trayasaṅgamāḥ || 6 ||
nānāśāstrānabhyāsa nānā yogamanabhyasaḥ | * * * * * * * * * * yatrādi doṣakā || 7 ||
kṛṣṇa varṇamanācārya vikaṭākṣa virodhakam | asaṃpradāya śuddhāyā'bhakṣya paradūṣaṇaḥ || 8 ||
tatvajñānamanabhyāsa ātmajñāna vivarjitaḥ | śivajñānaṃ navābhyāsa śivadroha * * * * || 9 ||
p. 42)
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * | aviśvāsa akāruṇyāti bhrāntasya lakṣaṇam |
sacchiṣya lakṣaṇa vivekaḥ ||
satyaśaucātmakāḥ śuddhāḥ kāmakrodhādi varjitaḥ | śāntirdānti yuparyukti svapakṣā pekṣā catuṣṭayaḥ || 11 ||
evaṃ sādhanasaṃyukta gurvājñāṃ paripālanaḥ | samayācāraṃ parācāraṃ lokācāraṃ ca varjitaḥ ||
trayeṣaṇa parityajya mānābhimāna varjitaḥ | ahorātrācārya sevya sumanaḥ sumukhasthitaḥ ||
ācārya kalpana jñāna niṣṭhopāya viśiṣṭhakaḥ | pañcapātaka kutsyārthamūḍha saṃsarga varjitaḥ ||
santānaṃ śāstra vidhimāne kāntaḥ sahasā saha | ityādi lakṣaṇairyuktaṃ sacchiṣyastasya lakṣaṇam ||
asacchiṣya vivekaḥ ||
aśāntaḥ śāstra sahaścādimūḍhādi sambhavaḥ | krūro vikalpako'ṅguṣṭha rohādi * * * * * ||
* * * śvāsādyudāsīna atimūḍho'varṇakaḥ ||
duḥśīla lakṣaṇo duṣṭadurācārā durbhāṣikaḥ | durmanā durmukhā duṣṭā guṇa ityarthaḥ sambhavāḥ ||
gurudroha śivadroha śāstrasvasamaya druhaḥ | santānadroha ityarthaṃ viṣayaṃ paripālanaḥ ||
evamādi guṇairyuktaṃ duḥśīlalasyasya lakṣaṇam ||
jñāna nirṇaya vivekaḥ ||
pāśa jñānaṃ paśujñānaṃ patijñānaṃ tridhottamam ||
* * * * * siddhāntadve bhinnā bhinna darśanam | satya bhānu bhava jñānamevaṃ jñānottamāṣṭamam ||
p. 43)
tadvetāntasya siddhānta madhye saṃsthitaṃ bhavet ||
jñānaṃ dvividhamākhyātaṃ paraṃ vācā paraṃ smṛtam | parañcaivāva bodhākhyaṃ paramaṃ śāstramuttamam ||
jñāna lakṣaṇākāra paṭalaḥ samāptaḥ ||
devyuvāca-
śivānanda jagannātha śivayogī maheśvaraḥ | sadācārthasya bhedārthaṃ dīkṣā * * * * * * ||
śuddha śaivasya siddhāntaṃ vedānta jñāna gocaram | dve bhinnā bhinna saṃketaṃ śuddhajñāna praveśakam ||
śuddhasāyujya sanmārgaṃ śuddhā śuddha pravartakam | paśupāśakṣayaṃ yogajñānarūpaṃ paraṃ guruḥ ||
guhyādguhyasya siddhāntamevaṃ dvādaśa bhedakam | kiṃ prakāreṇa kartavyaṃ tattallakṣaṇamucyate ||
īśvara uvāca-
śṛṇu praśnaṃ mahādevi sarvārtha saṃgraham | dvādaśa praśna tatvārthaṃ guhyādguhyaṃ śṛṇustathā ||
sadācārya gurusvāmī trividhaṃ tatra kalpanā | ācāryo bālya śikṣārthaṃ mantrastantra dhanaṃ guruḥ ||
upadeśa kramastvevaṃ tatsvāmistu vidhīyate | anyaṃ divyaṃ ca siddhiñcopāya trividho guruḥ ||
divyaṃ mānasa sambodho svaśivasyopakārakam | siddhaṃ sandarśano bhedaṃ śāstrakālāntara sthitam ||
sevakā vṛttikālānte pakvamasya bhavaṃ śivam | tat * * * stradīkṣārthe bodhakurvatyajāyakaḥ ||
p. 44)
vijñāna pralayaścaiva sakalatraidhādhikārikāḥ | paraḥ śivakaṭā * * baindava jñāna kalpanāḥ ||
vācyavācaka saṃbhinnā traidhātmā bodhasambhavāḥ | tridhā śiṣyaḥ tridhācāryaḥ tridhātvaṃ bodhanādṛśam ||
evamācārya siddhārthaṃ sadācārya pravartakam | sadbodhaṃ sadgururyuktaṃ sadānandātma sambhavam ||
|| ityācāryavivekaḥ ||
catuṣpādā nānāsamaya kalpanāḥ | paśujā * * * dīkṣā vaidikaḥ śaivamāmakāḥ ||
aneka śāmbhayo dīkṣā'nyatantrānya dīkṣitāḥ | aṣṭapādādayo * * * * jñāna svadīkṣayā ||
aṣṭasiddhyarthayo dīkṣā'ṣṭa grāhya guṇādhikāḥ | evamādi prabhedārtha lokamadhye tu kalpanāḥ ||
samayaṃ ca viśeṣañca nirvāṇaṃ śāmbhavaṃ tathā | abhiṣekāsīnaya sthāpya ṣaḍbhedaṃ śaivakāraṇam ||
jñānayogakriyā trīṇyā triṣaṭkaṃ pūrvokta dīkṣayā | siddhamārga prabhedārtha nānā dṛśya svadīkṣitāḥ ||
cākṣuṣī sparśadīkṣā ca vācakī mānasī tathā | śāstre ca yogadīkṣā ca hantā * * * nekathā ||
dīyate jñāna saṃbhavaṃ kṣīyate ca malatrayam | dīyate kṣīyate caiva dīkṣā śabda ihocyate ||
tasmātpāśa paśutvartthaṃ malapañcakamocanam | dīkṣā śabdasya kartavyaṃ tañjīvātma śivaikyakam | śuddhaśaivasva siddhāntaṃ śaivabhedaṃ kimucyate ||
anādi śaivamādiñca miśramaṃ ca tridhāya ca |
p. 45)
guruśaiva caturthantu pañcamāntara bhedakam | mahāśaivaḥ ṣaṣṭha bheda bheda śaivaṃ tu saptamam ||
abheda śai * * vidyāt yogaśaivannavaṃ tathā | jñāna śaivaṃ daśaṃ vidyādūrdhva śaiva ekādaśam ||
dvādaśamājñaśaivaṃ tu nanu śaivaṃ trayodaśam | artha śaivaṃ caturdaśyāṃ tatvaśaiva * * * * ||
ṣoḍaśaṃ śuddhaśaivaṃ ca śaivabhedamiti sthitam | paśupāśa patijñānaṃ śaivabhedārtha nirṇayam ||
vedāntaṃ śaiva siddhānta yogāntaṃ nādamantakam | bodhāntaṃ tatra pañcāntaṃ śuddha śaiva sudarśanam ||
tatrāva sthitaṃ śāntaṃ śuddhaśaiva pravartakam ||
|| śaivavivekaḥ samāptaḥ ||
atha śṛṇuṣva vedānta sarvaśāstra svasārakam | jīvātmā paramātmā ca dvayoraikyaṃ * * * * ||
satya jñānamanantaṃ cānandaṃ tatsvarūpakam | ekavākye bahuśāstrodayakaṃ na prakāśakam ||
ṛgyajuḥ sāmātharvāṇaḥ karmakāṇḍodbhavaṃ sthitāḥ | vedāntastu mahāvākya jīvanmukta prakāśakam ||
* * puṃsastu rūpaṃ yanmahāvākya svarūpakam | purāṇaṃ bhārataṃ śāstraṃ samayāṃ tatvavṛttikam ||
mantraśāstraṃ kathāśāstraṃ paśvaśāstraṃ vimohitam | vedāntaṃ śaivasiddhānta śivaśāstraṃ siddhamuktidam ||
tanmahāvākya śirasā traiyyāḥ pādātridhāya ca | triyakṣa śabalādehā trilakṣaṇa samudbhavaḥ ||
p. 46)
tridhā jāgratridhāsvapnaṃ tridhāsuptiṃ trituryakam | tripada tripadārthāya * tma jyoti svarūpakam ||
ityādi lakṣaṇairyuktaṃ tatvamasyeti rūpakam | bodhāmṛta surākāraṃ samayātīta gocaram ||
akārokāramakāra śirastri praṇavāṃśca * | śiva jīva parayoraikyaṃ tripādī lakṣalakṣaṇāḥ ||
śabalā parimitaṃ bhedaṃ tanmadhye ṣoḍaśottamam | jīvaṃ para girāmukti savyāpyastatralakṣaṇam ||
ātmajāgraṃ parojāgraṃ śivajāgraṃ trijāgrakam | ātmasvapnaṃ parasvapnaṃ śivasvapnaṃ trisvapnakam ||
ātma suptiparaṃ suptiṃ śivasuptaṃ trisuptakam | ātmaturyaṃ pare turyaṃ śivaturyaṃ trituryakam | evaṃ dvādaśadhā bhinnaṃ daśāvasthāḥ prakīrtitāḥ ||
jāgṛjāgraṃ jāgratsvapnaṃ jāgṛsupti tṛtīyakam | jāgraṃ turyaṃ caturthañca tatkāla parapañcamam ||
paravyomaṃ ṣaṣṭhamaṃ caiva parāvasthā tu saptamam | viśvagrāsāṣṭamañcaivopaśānto navastathā ||
śiva sṛṣṭā daśañcaiva vākyāvasthā daśeriti | tvaṃ padaṃ tatvapadaṃ dvedhā asitraidha iti padāḥ ||
ātmārthañca parārthañca śivārthañca tridhārthakāḥ | svaviśvaṃ tejasaṃ proktajña tridhāvasthā tṛtīyakāḥ ||
ādiśaktiḥ parāśaktiḥ śivaśaktiḥ triśaktayaḥ | etallakṣaṇa saṃyuktaṃ vedāntārtha vidhikramam ||
p. 47)
jīvanmukti paromukti śivamukti tṛtīyakam |
bhinnābhinna vivekaḥ-
śivohama smīti siddhāntaṃ so'hamasmiśrutāntakam | vedārthasāra saṃgrāhyannavatatvoditā gamam ||
tasmādvedānta sadbodhaṃ śaivasiddhānta darśanam | māyākuṇḍalinī madhye'ṇuḥ prāpya dvibhinnakam ||
ātmakevala saṃbodha jīvātmasvaprakāśakam | jāgra turyasusaṃbodhaṃ śrutyantātma svarūpakam ||
avasthā bhedaṃ tathā dānaṃ malātītaṃ svamātmanam | vedāgama dvibhinnā bhinnañcātma svarūpakam ||
vai bhinnābhinna sambandhaḥ svarūpaṃ caitanyarūpakam | abhinnamātma svarūpasthaṃ bhinnaṃ prakṛtirucyate ||
vākyārthaṃ praṇavārthañca mudrārthaṃ tatra darśanam | snānubhūtyartha saṃbodya śuddha jñāna praveśakam ||
śuddhajñāna prakāśārthaṃ śuddha sāyujya sambhavam | tatvatraya vikalpārthaṃ śuddhāśuddha dvimiśrakam ||
vedāntārthaṃ prabodhārthe svānubhūti prakāśakam | tasmānmahāvākyabhāvaṃ paśupāśadvimocanam ||
aṣṭāṅgāṃśuriti saṃgrahāntaṃ hi yogajñāna dvisaṃghaṭam | sarvāvasthā vinirmuktaṃ gururūpaṃ parātparam ||
guhyāṃ śāmbhava tadvaidhā guhyādguhyaṃ guroḥ param | pūrvokta dvādaśārthasya vicāraśceti śaṅkari ||
|| saṅgrahādhikāraḥ samāptaḥ ||
p. 48)
devyuvāca-
parameśa maheśāna parātparaparaḥ śivaḥ | siddhāntamārga saṃbodhaṃ kiṃ prakāaraṃ taducyate ||
īśvara uvāca-
śṛṇu devi mahābhāge śaivasiddhānta lakṣaṇam | pāśaṃ pāśupati jñeyaṃ tripadārthaṃ trinirṇayam ||
pāśaṃ pāśupatirmadhye tritridhāya tu dīkṣayaḥ ||
navamaḥ siddhāntādhikāraḥ ||
tasmāddaśavidho dīkṣā paśupāśa patikramāt | prathamaṃ tatvarūpāṇi dvitīyaṃ tatvadarśakam ||
tṛtīyaṃ tatva śuddhyarthaṃ caturthamātmarūpakam | pañcamamāhaśyantu ṣaṣṭhamātmaśodhanam ||
sarvatatvaścaturbheda māyākuṇḍalinodbhavam | pūrvoktasya sva kartavyaṃ tatvatraya viśeṣataḥ ||
tatvarūpamitistatra tatvaṃ darśanabhāvanam | tatvaśuddhi pṛthagrūpa karmabhāvaṃ tatvaśūnya sthitaṃ kuru ||
arūpā varṇacaitanyamavikārāntagocaram | abhinnā bhinna yacchūnya ityarthamātmarūpakam ||
api kārotpanna yat prajñā tattatvannāṇurūpakam | tadvyāptaṃ cetasorūpaṃ tatsarvaṃ svaprakāśakam ||
tadvyoma saṃbhavatyarthaḥ tadavasthātma śodhanam | rūpārūpaṃ dvidhā śūnyaṃ turyātītaṃ paraṃ śivam ||
tatvadaṃ paramaṃ sthāṇu tatvātītaṃ paraṃ śivam |
atha śiva darśana vivekaḥ -
aṇoraṇīyān mahato mahīyānnātmā'sya jantornihito guhāyām |
p. 49)
upādhiśūnya svayamātmamadhye prakāśa tadjñapti parānubhāvaḥ ||
svajīvaparayoraikyaṃ śivayogaṃ śivodbhavam | daśāvasthā yutikrāntaṃ parāvasthā vimarśanam ||
svarūpaṃ satyādiguṇaṃ vākyalakṣaṇaśodhanam | satyānandaṃ mahājyoti śivabhogānu bhūtikam ||
|| siddhānta darśanādhikāraḥ samāptaḥ ||
devyuvāca-
devadeva jagannātha śivaśūlin maheśvara | daśāvasthā prasiddhyarthaṃ jīvanmukti prayatnakam ||
sva jīvaparayoraikyaṃ kimupāyaṃ taducyate | atiguhyaṃ mahāguhyaṃ śuddha jñānaṃ śṛṇu priye ||
dīkṣācāra vivekaḥ-
śarīramarthaṃ prāṇaṃ ca sadgurubhyo nivedayet | dīrghadaṇḍa namaskāraṃ nirlajjā gurusannidhau ||
paścātvekantu tatproktaṃ śivahasta sthiraṃ śivam | karuṇā darśanībhāvāt puṇyapāpadvayaṃ harim ||
śrīpadaṃ śira dhārāḥ ca so'hamastīti bhāvanāt | jīvanmukti paromuktiḥ śivamuktistu sambhavam ||

p. 68)
